name: Pulsar Summer Residential (Purdue GER2I, grades 9 to 12)
org: Purdue University Gifted Education Research and Resource Institute (GER2I)
what_you_do: Live in a Purdue residence hall for two weeks. You take challenging courses with other gifted and talented students. The program also includes field trips and recreation.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 (the Pulsar level). New students send an essay or other media about their interest. They also send two of these. One is a transcript with a 3.5 GPA in the talent area. Others are a test score of 120 or higher on an intelligence test and a 90th percentile achievement or aptitude test. A teacher or mentor letter counts. So does proof of involvement such as awards.
pay_detail: 2026 listing: $2,990 per session for Star or Pulsar, plus a $100 application fee (refunded only if not accepted). Optional $100 Saturday field trip. A 5% early bird discount applied by Feb 17. A limited number of partial scholarships exist for students with financial need, first come, first served.
deadline_text: 2026: registration opened Feb 2, 2026. Camp ran June 28 to July 25, 2026 in two sessions (June 28 to July 11, July 12 to 25). Payment was due June 1. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application through the Purdue conferences site (the Register Now link on the program page). Upload your essay or media and two supporting documents. Questions: geri@purdue.edu or 765-494-7210.
notes: Costs money and is a camp, not a job. The details on this card came from a summarized fetch of the program page. The raw page would not load for a second check. Confirm the Pulsar price, dates and application steps with geri@purdue.edu or 765-494-7210 before you plan. The page also lists other prices ($1,250 commuter and $1,495 residential per session). They may be for the younger levels.
